text:
maya: FYI we're targeting a staggered deploy tonight 22:00 UTC for runtime, router, and console. Canary window 10m then ramp if green. Need explicit pins and gate confirmation from owners @sam @jordan @alex @priya

sam: Runtime ok. Shipping 3.4.1-rc with eviction-latch fix. Suggest pin only for canary; keep 3.4.0 as global fallback. Load tests fine for 512 tokens.

jordan: Router change (header-split) depends on console header contract v2. If console not ready, we can keep header-split disabled via feature flag during canary.

alex: Console backend implements v2, admin UI needs mapping update. We can delay UI deploy; backend is backward compatible.

priya: API team: no breaking changes. Recommend increasing gateway routing TTL to 60s to allow KV cache warmup in canary.

maya: Plan: sam pin runtime 3.4.1-rc for canary, jordan set header-split=false for canary, alex hold UI, priya set gateway TTL=60s. Release notes to mention eviction-latch fix & header-split toggle.

sam: Pinning runtime canary now: ```orchctl pin --service runtime --version 3.4.1-rc --scope canary --metadata "eviction_latch=true"```

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by maya. Canary kick in 15m.

maya: Canary ramp: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m if metrics stay green. SLOs: error rate <1%, p95 latency < +30% vs baseline, no top-tier customer errors. Rollback thresholds defined.

ops-bot: Preflight OK: infra capacity in eu-west-1 and us-east-1.

(deploy starts)
deploy-bot: Canary started: runtime=3.4.1-rc (10%), router header-split=false, console backend v2, gateway TTL=60s. Monitor: https://console/mon/runtimes/3.4.1-rc

jordan: Noticing an uptick in router p95 queueing on auth-proxy routes, +45ms on subset.

sam: Kernel logs show transient KV eviction spikes during warmup; not steady yet.

alex: Admin API 502 spike: error rate from 0.6% -> 1.8% for ~90s, looks like console->router handshake timingouts.

maya: Close to thresholds. Reminder: rollback if error rate >2% for 3m or p95 >300ms for 2m.

jordan: auth-proxy p95 just hit 320ms sustained ~2m.

priya: Seeing customer-facing errors for a small subset of production keys; vendor federation alerted.

maya: Given p95 breach + vendor alert + 502s, I authorize rollback now. Sam and Jordan, execute rollback.

sam: Rolling runtime back to 3.4.0: ```orchctl rollback --service runtime --to-version 3.4.0 --reason "canary p95 & vendor errors"```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for runtime. Canary halted. Unpinning router feature flag.
jordan: Reverting router flag globally: ```orchctl set-flag router header-split false --scope global --source canary-revert``` 12; done.

ops-bot: Connections normalized; eviction spikes subsiding. p95 back under baseline within 90s.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: runtime -> 3.4.0. Router flag confirmed. Canary aborted.

maya: Good catch team. Action items: deep RCA for console handshake with header-split + runtime warmup interactions. Mark 3.4.1-rc as blocked pending perf tuning in release notes.

alex: I'll update release doc and add UI toggle to postpone admin UI mapping.

sam: Follow-ups: implement controlled KV warmup, extend canary ramp by +5m next attempt, add eviction-burst metric and alert.

maya: We'll do a post-deploy sync tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Cluster stable. Thanks :thumbsup:

priya: Leaving a release note stub: "Eviction latch candidate rolled back after canary; see postmortem."

deploy-bot: Thread closed by maya.
